subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept client-capability-gated tool availability plus a bundled Canvas `show_widget` web-chat widget tool as the supported direction for this issue?
rationale: The requested work adds durable plugin/tool API surface and a model-authored markup sandbox boundary, so code inspection cannot substitute for maintainer product and security ownership.

options.title: Review the linked implementation PR
options.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing its review blockers and explicitly accepting the API/security boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign the API seam first
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Reject bundled widget support
options.body: Close the implementation path and route this to external plugin or ClawHub experimentation until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Review the linked implementation PR
recommendation.body: Use the open implementation PR as the candidate path, fixing its review blockers and explicitly accepting the API/security boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the active implementation candidate and is the clearest current routing point for accepting or reshaping the product/API direction.
